summary: On November 13, 2025 an unauthorized third party gained access to the email account of an employee in First Advantage Corporation's Drug & Occupational Health Screening Unit through sophisticated phishing and downloaded the contents of the inbox. The background screening company discovered the breach on November 17, disabled the account and later notified affected individuals, whose exposed information included names, Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers and other personal data. It offered two years of credit monitoring.
